annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because the speaker promotes a Fetch Rewards sign-up offer involving a small Target or Amazon gift card, a description link and code, receipt scanning, and gift-card redemption. The service is described as a receipt-scanning rewards app for people who do not already use it, which fits an ordinary referral or rebate-style promotion. Discussion of illness and holding NyQuil is incidental and does not establish a separate deceptive solicitation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central observed context is an ordinary rewards promotion: viewers are told to sign up for a receipt-scanning app, scan receipts, accumulate points, and redeem gift cards. The evidence supports a rewards or referral promotion without establishing that the external service is safe or that redemption occurred.
